title: NAT vs tests depend on sonic-buildimage changes
author: daall
body: The NAT vs tests have a dependency on Azure/sonic-buildimage#3494. Once that PR is merged, the tests need to be re-enabled in swss.

linkedPullRequests.title: [dvs] Add NAT tests back to test suite
linkedPullRequests.author: daall
linkedPullRequests.body:
- Validate that NAT processes are running on dvs
- Mark tests as xfail so results can be monitored

Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <daall@microsoft.com>
